title: Verification scenario envelope
description: Draft. A replayable trace. The envelope is project-agnostic; `initial` and `steps` are opaque to the toolkit and interpreted only by the project's ScenarioTarget.

bounds.description: Backend-reported bounds under which this trace was found. Free-form; retained for report honesty.

initial.description: Opaque initial state, interpreted by ScenarioTarget::init.

steps.description: Opaque steps, deserialized into the target's Step type.

expect.description: invariant_violated = regression scenario. invariant_holds = pinned golden trace. unreproduced = incident-derived trace that replay could not reproduce, retained as evidence of a model gap.

fingerprint.description: Content hash over the normalized scenario, used for corpus dedup.

status.description: quarantined = failed the determinism check and is not a CI gate.

reference.description: Issue, PR, or incident reference. Never a raw log payload.
